title: The Simple Membership plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including,…
description: The Simple Membership plugin for WordPress contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in all versions up to and including 4.9.0. This flaw allows authenticated users with Contributor-level access or higher to escalate their privileges to full Administrator role. The issue arises because the bulk operation function improperly allows selection of membership level 1 (administrator) without proper restrictions, provided the plugin's admin access permission setting has been lowered from its default. Exploitation does not require bypassing nonce protections due to the accessible page context for lower-privileged users.
